subject: Aurora Health pilot — request to maintain sandbox access while PO routes
messages:
From: Nidhi Shah <nidhi.shah@aurorahealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@aurorahealth.com
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 14:12:00 -0500
Subject: Aurora Health pilot — request to maintain sandbox access while PO routes

Hi Tessa,

Quick context: our legal/finance teams signed off on the PO yesterday but it needs to get one more internal approver before it leaves procurement. That step is expected to complete within 5–7 business days, but the procurement queue is a bit backed up right now.

We're about to lose production access to the Redwood sandbox tomorrow which would interrupt a critical demo and the integration work the clinical team is finalizing. The pilot metrics are looking good (see attached summary) — we've hit the latency and accuracy targets you and Ben helped set.

Would Redwood be able to temporarily extend our sandbox access or issue a short-term credit so we can keep the pilot live while the PO routes? We don't need anything fancy — just enough runway to finish integration tests and run the scheduled executive demo next week. If helpful, we're prepared to provide a sketch of the expected PO date and the PO number once it's available.

Appreciate any flexibility here.

Thanks,
Nidhi Shah
Senior Manager, Clinical Integrations
Aurora Health

[Attachment: pilot-usage-summary.csv (CSV, 42KB)]

From: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Nidhi Shah <nidhi.shah@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aurora Health pilot — request to maintain sandbox access while PO routes

Hi Nidhi — thanks for the heads up and for the usage summary, that helps a lot.

Short answer: we can help. Below is what I can propose immediately so we don't interrupt your work:

- Provision a temporary 5,000-token credit into your sandbox account, expiring 7 days from provisioning.
- If the PO clears earlier we will reconcile pro‑rata usage against the eventual invoice.

Before I push this through I need two quick things: an expected PO clearance date (even a best guess) and confirmation of the exact sandbox org id you're using so the credits go to the right place. If procurement prefers a voucher or short-term invoice instead, let me know and we can route to finance/ops.

Ben and Marissa — looping you in for approvals and provisioning. Ben, Marissa: can we provision the 5k as a one-off emergency credit? I put the deal id RDW-2026-AUR-78 on the request.

Next steps for Nidhi: reply with PO ETA and your sandbox org id (or PO number when available) and I'll act immediately.

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198

Ben
